claims.text: The BERT-based model encodes query relevance and document context into vector representations using BERT, which are then used to predict sentence scores.
The model takes the concatenation of the query and document as input, using a self-attention mechanism to model relationships between queries and sentences.
Input representations are constructed by summing token, segmentation, and position embeddings, with special tokens indicating sentence boundaries.
The model is fine-tuned on datasets like WikiRef and DUC to improve performance in extractive summarization tasks.
